product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™Pro‑series 4K60 Multiviewer: Seamless UHD Video Switcher for Professional AV Installations | HDMI 2.0b, HDCP 2.2 and 1.x | Audio ExtractionEffortlessly Display Multiple UHD Video Feeds on One Screen with the Blackbird Pro‑Series 4K60 MultiviewerProfessional‑Grade Performance and Versatility Experience the power of the Blackbird™ by Monoprice™ Pro‑series 4K60 Multiviewer, designed for professional AV installations. This advanced video switcher seamlessly combines up to four video signals onto a single UHD or HD display, offering stunning visual quality and immersive audio. Seamless Multiviewing ExperienceWith its seamless switching capability, this video switcher allows you to effortlessly switch between input channels and create custom combinations of multiple images on a single UHD monitor. Whether you're a professional AV installer, AV production specialist, or IT professional, the Blackbird™ Pro‑series delivers the performance you need.Enhanced Control and ConnectivityGain full control over your audio and video experience. The Blackbird™ Pro‑series supports various input and output resolutions up to 4K@60Hz, ensuring crisp and vibrant visuals. It complies with HDMI 2.0b and HDCP 2.2 standards, guaranteeing compatibility with the latest devices and content.Multiple Display Modes and Audio FlexibilityChoose from a range of display modes, including Single, PIP, PBP, Triple, and Quad, to customize your viewing experience. The device supports up to 7.1 audio channels, including LPCM, AC3, DD+, DTS, and DTS‑HD, providing immersive sound quality. The audio de‑embedding feature allows for easy integration with external audio distribution systems.Easy Control and InstallationControl the Blackbird Pro‑series 4K60 Multiviewer effortlessly through various methods, including front panel buttons, IR remote, OSD menu navigation, and RS‑232. Its compact design and included mounting ears make installation a breeze, ensuring seamless integration into your AV setup.Broad Applications and Value PropositionThe Blackbird™ Pro‑series is ideal for a wide range of applications, including corporate presentations, digital signage, control rooms, education and training facilities, hospitality and tourism, museums and exhibitions, and medical imaging.
